tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Full details of ONE Koenig Solutions course: name, code, page url, vendor, technology, level, duration, overview, who should attend, prerequisites, what you will learn, curriculum, skills gained, career roles and hiring companies, exam format and cost, FAQs, course outline PDF and delivery options (

tools.name: list_technology_courses
tools.description: All Koenig Solutions courses for a technology, as listed on that technology's page (the technology and its direct sub-technologies), the technology's own courses first, then most popular. Each course has name, code, url, vendor, level and duration. Paged: total, page, page_size, total_pages. other_t

tools.name: list_vendor_courses
tools.description: All Koenig Solutions courses of a vendor (e.g. Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, Red Hat), most popular first. Each course has name, code, url, technology, level and duration. Also returns technologies: the vendor's main technologies with course counts - for a big vendor offer those to the user and use list_te

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search Koenig Solutions' live IT training catalog. Accepts a course name, exam or course code (e.g. 'AZ-104', 'DP-600'), technology, vendor or a short topic ('azure devops', 'oracle dba'). Returns the best-matching courses, best first, each with name, code, course page URL, technology, level, vendor

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "koenig-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_course_details, list_technology_courses, list_vendor_courses, search_courses · Public sink: search_courses · Destructive: get_course_details.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_course_details, list_technology_courses, list_vendor_courses, search_courses · Public sink: search_courses · Destructive: get_course_details

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
